value_stream.name: Customer Pickup, Loading Zone & Will-Call Counter Operations

fields.Participants: Forklift Operators, Spotters (W4971), Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24), Customer Safety (VS-147)
fields.Volume: ~5–15 bulky mechanical-loading events per store per day × 200 stores

workflows.name: Forklift & Loading Equipment Operations in the Customer Vehicle Area

Automation Opportunity: - Operator-qualification-interlock on equipment; telematics/geofence (operator-zone); near-miss capture
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: qualified operator only; spotter present; designated envelope; pre-use inspection; incident reported (VS-24/VS-147)
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE/forklift), VS-147 (premises safety), VS-35/VS-138 (equipment/maintenance), W4964 (layout), W4970 (loading), W4971 (spotter), W4973 (qualification)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Contact-injury risk**: Forklift contact with customer/pedestrian/vehicle (VS-147); mitigated by spotter, demarcation, and speed/horn controls
- **Unauthorized-use risk**: Unqualified operator using equipment → accident; mitigated by qualification gate (W4973)
- **Equipment-failure risk**: Defective forklift in use; mitigated by pre-use inspection (W4973)
System Touchpoints: - Equipment/asset & maintenance (VS-35/VS-138); HSE (VS-24); incident reporting (VS-147/VS-24); CMMS (VS-138)

steps.activity: Authorize & dispatch the forklift/loading equipment to the customer area: only qualified operators (W4973), only in the designated envelope (W4964), with a spotter (W4971), horn/lights/blue-light, and pedestrian-vehicle separation active (links VS-147)

Operate the equipment safely in the customer area: controlled speed, clear travel path, load lowered except lifting, no passengers, horn at intersections, and immediate stop on pedestrian incursion; coordinate with the spotter (W4971)
Return, inspect & log: return equipment to designated parking/charging, log usage/hours, note defects (W4973), and report any near-miss/incident to HSE (VS-24) and customer-safety (VS-147 CAPA)

fields.Participants: Loaders, Forklift Operators (W4969), Spotters (W4971), Store Ops (VS-07), CX (VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Counter release (W4962); appointment (W4963); customer at loading bay
fields.Volume: ~7–10 bulky loads per store per day × 200 stores (per W950)

workflows.name: Bulky-Goods Loading into Customer Vehicles (Lumber, Tile, Cement, Appliance)

Automation Opportunity: - Load-plan from order dimensions; completeness scan; damage-photo capture at bay; CX feedback prompt
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: order verified; vehicle suitability checked; load secured (W4972); completeness/condition confirmed with customer
Cross-references: - links to VS-10/VS-16 (order), VS-04 (staging), VS-115 (scales), VS-32/VS-13/VS-90 (damage/return/claim), W4962 (counter), W4968 (vehicle), W4969 (forklift), W4971 (spotter), W4972 (securement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Damage risk**: Goods or vehicle damaged during loading → return/complaint/claim (VS-32/VS-13/VS-90); mitigated by trained loading and protection
- **Incomplete-load risk**: Item left behind → customer return/extra trip; mitigated by completeness check
- **Overload risk**: Vehicle overloaded → unsafe/illegal (LTFRB/LTO); mitigated by W4972
System Touchpoints: - Order mgmt (VS-10/VS-16); WMS/staging (VS-04); calibration (VS-115 — scales); CX (VS-13); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Prepare the load & vehicle: confirm the order/items (from W4962), position the customer vehicle in the bay, verify vehicle suitability (W4968), and plan the load (order, weight distribution W4972, securement points)

Load the bulky goods: load lumber (length/cantilever), tile (pallet/crate), cement (bags/pallet), appliances (W4976 fragile/hazardous), using the forklift (W4969) or manual handling (W4975), with the spotter (W4971) guiding; protect the vehicle and goods from damage

Secure & hand off: secure the load (W4972), confirm completeness/condition with the customer, capture the load/release confirmation, advise the customer on safe transport, and clear the bay for the next pickup

fields.Participants: Spotters, Forklift Operators (W4969), Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24), Customer Safety (VS-147)

workflows.name: Spotter, Banksperson & Pedestrian-Safety Protocol for Customer-Area Loading

Automation Opportunity: - Spotter-required gate (no mechanical load without spotter logged); pedestrian-detection sensors; near-miss capture
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: spotter mandatory for mechanical loading; signals briefed; stop-on-incursion; incident reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-147 (premises safety), W4969 (forklift), W4970 (loading), W4972 (securement), W4964 (layout)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pedestrian-incursion risk**: Customer walks into the travel/fall envelope → injury (VS-147); mitigated by mandatory spotter and stop-on-incursion
- **Communication-failure risk**: Operator and spotter out of sync → accident; mitigated by established signals and briefing
- **Spotter-absent risk**: Loading without a spotter → uncontrolled hazard; mitigated by the no-spotter-no-load control

steps.activity: Position & brief the spotter: for every mechanical load in the customer area, assign a spotter/banksperson, brief on the path/load/blind-spots, and establish hand-signal/verbal/radio communication with the operator

Control pedestrians & vehicles during loading: the spotter keeps customers/vehicles/pedestrians clear of the swing/fall/travel envelope, stops the operator on any incursion, and manages the bay/queue (links VS-147 premises safety)
Confirm completion & safety: signal all-clear on completion, confirm load securement (W4972), release the customer vehicle, and report any near-miss/incident (VS-24/VS-147)

workflows.name: Load Securement, Weight Distribution & Vehicle Overload Prevention

Automation Opportunity: - Weight/dimension auto-estimate from order; securement checklist; overload alert; advice template
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: weight distribution planned; load secured to rating; overload refused; customer advised; documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-147 (premises/liability), VS-115 (scales), VS-06/VS-143/VS-162 (alternatives), VS-100 (liability), W4968 (vehicle suitability), W4970 (loading)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Load-shift risk**: Unsecured cargo shifts/rolls in transit → road incident/liability (VS-147); mitigated by securement protocol
- **Overload risk**: Vehicle overloaded → unsafe, illegal, damage, LTFRB/LTO exposure; mitigated by weight check and refusal of unsafe load
- **Liability risk**: Customer injury/damage from a load BuildRight loaded → premises/product-liability (VS-147/VS-100); mitigated by securement and advice

steps.activity: Plan weight distribution & load order: distribute weight across the vehicle axles, place heavy items low/forward, balance side-to-side, and stay within the vehicle's payload/load rating (links W4968 suitability)

Secure the load: strap/tie-down/chock/block the cargo (lumber/tile/cement/appliance), verify securement points and strap rating, and prevent shift/rollover in transit (links VS-147 — load-shift injury/liability)

Prevent overload & advise the customer: weigh/estimate the load (links VS-115 scales for catch-weight/bulk), refuse unsafe overload (offer delivery VS-06/VS-143 or larger rental VS-162), advise the customer on safe transport/securement, and document

workflows.name: Forklift Operator Qualification, Equipment Inspection & DOLE OSH Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - Operator-qualification-interlock on equipment; pre-use checklist app; defect tag-out workflow; re-cert scheduling
Controls: - CTL-97 (ensure will-call release integrity & loading safety.)
- CTL-744: qualified/certified operators only; pre-use inspection logged; defective equipment tagged out; DOLE-OSH audited
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-19.4 (training), VS-83 (occupational health), VS-169 (PPE), VS-35/VS-138 (equipment/CMMS), VS-21 (audit), W4969 (operations), W4971 (spotter)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unqualified-operator risk**: Uncertified operator → accident + DOLE liability; mitigated by qualification gate
- **Equipment-defect risk**: Defective forklift in use → accident; mitigated by pre-use inspection and tag-out
- **Compliance-failure risk**: DOLE-OSH non-compliance → penalty/officer liability; mitigated by audit and records
System Touchpoints: - HSE/compliance (VS-24); training/LMS (VS-19.4); equipment/CMMS (VS-35/VS-138); occupational health (VS-83); PPE (VS-169); audit (VS-21)
Time Estimate: - ~per-operator qualification days/weeks; ~daily pre-use 10–15 min/equipment; ~periodic audit per cycle

steps.activity: Qualify operators per DOLE OSH (forklift/reach-truck): training, certification/licensing, competency assessment, medical/fitness (links VS-83), PPE issuance (VS-169), and the operator register; only qualified operators use equipment in the customer area (W4969)

Inspect equipment pre-use: daily pre-use inspection (forks, brakes, hydraulics, tires, lights/horn, seatbelt), defect tag-out, and maintenance/refuel/charge per the schedule (links VS-138/VS-35); no defective equipment in service
Audit & comply: periodic DOLE-OSH forklift compliance audit, operator re-certification, equipment maintenance records, incident investigation (VS-24), and feed the customer-safety program (VS-147)

Automation Opportunity: - Curbside check-in app; assistance-request routing; manual-handling-equipment standards
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: assistance provided on request; PWD priority; safe manual handling; curbside designated/controlled
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-13 (CX/PWD access), VS-24 (manual handling), VS-147 (safety), W4962 (verify), W4965 (staging), W4970 (loading)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Manual-handling-injury risk**: Staff/customer injury carrying heavy goods (VS-24); mitigated by equipment (carts/dollies) and technique
- **Accessibility risk**: PWD/elderly not served (RA 7277); mitigated by priority assistance
- **Curbside-conflict risk**: Curbside vehicle/pedestrian conflict; mitigated by designated spots and controls

steps.activity: Provide carry-out assistance: for customers needing help (elderly, PWD, bulky/heavy items), staff carry/assist goods to the vehicle, with carts/dollies and safe manual handling (links VS-24 manual handling, VS-147)

Operate curbside/drive-up pickup: customer parks in a designated curbside/drive-up spot, staff bring the staged order (W4965) to the vehicle, verify (W4962), and load (W4970); manage the curbside queue
Manage accessibility & safety: PWD/elderly/special-assistance priority (RA 7277/BP 344), safe manual handling to prevent injury (staff and customer), and incident reporting (VS-24/VS-147)

workflows.name: Bulk Material Breaking, Handling & Yard-to-Vehicle Transfer

Automation Opportunity: - Scale→ERP auto-posting (VS-115); break→inventory auto-update; measurement-to-sale auto-recon
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: calibrated scales (VS-115); break posted to inventory; quantity reconciled to sale; safe handling
Cross-references: - links to VS-09.1 (W951 bulk breaking), VS-05/VS-05.1 (inventory/accuracy), VS-08 (catch-weight POS), VS-115 (calibration), W4969 (forklift), W4971 (spotter), W4972 (securement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Measurement-error risk**: Inaccurate break/weight → revenue/AR error or customer dispute; mitigated by calibrated scales (VS-115)
- **Inventory-accuracy risk**: Break not posted → variance (VS-05.1); mitigated by immediate inventory update
- **Handling-injury risk**: Manual bulk handling injury (VS-24); mitigated by equipment and technique
System Touchpoints: - Inventory (VS-05); POS catch-weight (VS-08); calibration/scales (VS-115); WMS/yard (VS-04); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Break bulk & measure: break bulk stock (cement bags from pallet, lumber board-foot cut, catch-weight nails/wire — links VS-09.1 W951 bulk breaking, VS-115 scales), measure/weigh accurately, and stage for the customer

Transfer yard-to-vehicle: move the broken/measured bulk to the customer vehicle (manual or forklift W4969), with the spotter (W4971) and securement (W4972), and update inventory on the break (links VS-05)
Reconcile & document: reconcile the broken/measured quantity to the sale (links VS-08 catch-weight, VS-115 calibration), document the break/transfer, and feed inventory accuracy (VS-05.1)

workflows.name: Hazardous / Fragile / High-Value Goods Loading Protocol

Automation Opportunity: - Goods-class→protocol auto-flag; DG segregation check; high-value release-auth gate
Controls: - CTL-744 (ensure controlled execution — Bulky-Goods Loading, Forklift-in-Customer-Area & Vehicle Coordination (PA-171.2).)
- CTL-744: goods-specific protocol applied; DG segregated/secured; fragile protected; high-value LP-controlled; incidents reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-114 (DG), VS-23 (LP/high-value), VS-24 (HSE), VS-32/VS-90 (damage/claim), VS-147 (safety), W4970 (loading), W4972 (securement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **DG-incident risk**: Leak/spill/reaction during loading (VS-114/VS-24); mitigated by segregation and protocol
- **Fragile-damage risk**: Damage to glass/appliance → return/claim (VS-32/VS-90); mitigated by protection/orientation
- **Theft risk**: High-value goods pilfered at pickup (VS-23); mitigated by LP oversight and release controls
System Touchpoints: - DG compliance (VS-114); LP (VS-23); HSE (VS-24); order mgmt (VS-10/VS-16); incident reporting (VS-24/VS-114)

steps.activity: Apply the goods-specific loading protocol: DG/hazmat (paint/solvent/gas cylinder/LPG — links VS-114 DG compliance, segregation/securement/ventilation); fragile (glass, ceramic, appliance — protection/orientation); high-value (power tools, copper — LP oversight VS-23)
Load safely per protocol: segregate incompatible DG, secure cylinders/fragile/high-value, prevent damage/leak/theft, advise the customer on transport (DG restrictions, fragile handling), and document
Comply & report: ensure DG customer-handoff compliance (links VS-114), high-value release controls (links VS-23), and incident/leak/damage reporting (VS-24/VS-114/VS-147)
